verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing documents API-driven card creation (paymentInstrument resource), card updates via /paymentInstruments/{id}, card lifecycle states, and transaction rules for spend controls, so an agent could operate much of the card program through the API. Transaction visibility is documented only through the Customer Area UI and payment/transfer webhooks, not a read API. missing for 10: an MCP surface, documented scoped or least-privilege API credentials for agents, explicit API endpoints for reading balances and transactions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can operate my card program — read balances and transactions, create and update cards, and adjust spend controls through the API or an MCP surface with scoped credentials

citations.quote: To issue a card, create a **paymentInstrument** resource.
To update the balance account ID, make a /paymentInstruments/{id} request and send the new balanceAccountId.
You can use transaction rules to configure a logic that automatically declines an authorization that does not meet your business' requirements.
These webhooks inform you when a merchant initiates a payment, and when funds have been added to or deducted from balance accounts.
